figurative_meaning_bn: আত্মগোপন করা; পালিয়ে যাওয়া; লুকানো; লুকিয়ে চলাফেরা করা
figurative_meaning_en: to hide oneself; to flee; to conceal; to move about secretly
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশের ভয়ে সে গা ঢাকা দিয়েছে।
অপরাধীরা সুযোগ পেয়ে গা ঢাকা দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He went into hiding out of fear of the police.
The criminals took cover when they got the chance.
note: This idiom is widely used in Bengali literature and everyday speech to describe evasion or secrecy, often in contexts of wrongdoing.
